description: This file provides helper functions for fetching available models for a user or team, handling wildcards, and generating display names for models, used within a dashboard UI component.

methods.name: fetchAvailableModelsForTeamOrKey
methods.description: Fetches a list of available models for a user or team, considering access tokens and roles, and sorts them with provider models first.

methods.name: getModelDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable display name for a model, handling special cases and wildcards.

methods.name: unfurlWildcardModelsInList
methods.description: Expands models with wildcards ('/*') into their constituent models based on all available models.
